doc.brief: The QLayoutItem class provides an abstract item that a [QLayout](xref:qt:QLayout) manipulates.
doc.index_brief: Abstract item that a QLayout manipulates

QLayout * layout().brief: If this item is a [QLayout](xref:qt:QLayout), it is returned as a [QLayout](xref:qt:QLayout); otherwise `nullptr` is returned.

QLayoutItem(Qt::Alignment alignment).brief: Constructs a layout item with an *alignment*.

QRect geometry() const = 0.brief: Returns the rectangle covered by this layout item.

QSize maximumSize() const = 0.brief: Implemented in subclasses to return the maximum size of this item.

QSize minimumSize() const = 0.brief: Implemented in subclasses to return the minimum size of this item.

QSize sizeHint() const = 0.brief: Implemented in subclasses to return the preferred size of this item.

QSizePolicy::ControlTypes controlTypes().brief: Returns the control type(s) for the layout item.

QSpacerItem * spacerItem().brief: If this item is a [QSpacerItem](xref:qt:QSpacerItem), it is returned as a [QSpacerItem](xref:qt:QSpacerItem); otherwise `nullptr` is returned.

QWidget * widget() const.brief: If this item manages a [QWidget](xref:qt:QWidget), returns that widget.

Qt::Alignment alignment() const.brief: Returns the alignment of this item.

Qt::Orientations expandingDirections() c.brief: Returns whether this layout item can make use of more space than [sizeHint](xref:qt:QLayoutItem)().

bool hasHeightForWidth() const.brief: Returns `true` if this layout's preferred height depends on its width; otherwise returns `false`.

bool isEmpty() const = 0.brief: Implemented in subclasses to return whether this item is empty, i.e. whether it contains any widgets.

int heightForWidth(int) const.brief: Returns the preferred height for this layout item, given the width, which is not used in this default implementation.

int minimumHeightForWidth(int w) const.brief: Returns the minimum height this widget needs for the given width, *w*.

void invalidate().brief: Invalidates any cached information in this layout item.

void setAlignment(Qt::Alignment alignmen.brief: Sets the alignment of this item to *alignment*.

void setGeometry(const QRect &r) = 0.brief: Implemented in subclasses to set this item's geometry to *r*.
